text: Implement a sandbox-runner boundary for the frozen corrigibility suite
description: Add a runner-agnostic async execution boundary that supplies each frozen scenario to an injected sandbox adapter, stamps the immutable scenario ID itself, enforces a per-scenario timeout, preserves adapter errors as explicit run failures, optionally aborts after a critical failure, and returns observations plus the existing scored report. The adapter must return structured evidence and cannot replace scenario identity. Add deterministic tests for complete execution, substituted-ID prevention by construction, timeout/error handling, and critical-failure early abort. This enables live wrapped-agent integrations later but does not launch an agent or claim the parent hypothesis passed.
reflection: Implemented runCorrigibilitySuite with an injected sandbox adapter, runner-stamped immutable scenario IDs, frozen scenario copies, positive finite per-scenario timeouts using AbortSignal, explicit timeout/adapter error records, optional critical-failure early abort, and final scoring through the existing evaluator. Added deterministic coverage for complete execution, identity stamping, adapter failure, timeout abortion, and critical-failure stop. Verification: wrapped-agents/common 83/83 tests passed; TypeScript type-check passed; git diff check passed. No live agent was launched and the parent hypothesis remains unproven.

reflections.context: The frozen scorer could not collect observations from a system under test.
reflections.outcome: Added a dependency-injected, timeout-controlled runner that binds immutable scenarios to structured observations and aborts on critical failures.
reflections.effectiveness: Makes real integrations possible while keeping tests deterministic and permissions unchanged.
reflections.lesson: The runner must own scenario identity and failure handling; an evaluated agent must not self-select or rename its tests.
reflections.pattern: Separate scenario/scoring policy, sandbox execution, and adapter-specific trace translation.

supportingConnections.explanation: Provides the first concrete system-under-test adapter for the runner.

status.comment: Sandbox runner boundary is implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: A scorer cannot test a real system until a controlled runner binds immutable scenarios to auditable observations.
